landmarks.name: Santiago Capital Hub
landmarks.desc: National capital and primary distribution command hub of Central Chile.

landmarks.name: Mendoza Distribution Center
landmarks.desc: Primary logistical capital on the Argentine eastern slope of the Andes.

landmarks.name: San Antonio Deepwater Port
landmarks.desc: Chile's largest container shipping terminal connected to the trans-Andean corridor.

landmarks.name: Valparaíso Commercial Port
landmarks.desc: Historic seaport terminal handling breakbulk and intermodal freight.

landmarks.name: Paso Los Libertadores (Cristo Redentor)
landmarks.desc: Crucial high-altitude international tunnel linking Chile and Argentina (Mercosur Lifeline).

landmarks.name: Portillo Alpine Base
landmarks.desc: Emergency staging base and ski center immediately below the international tunnel.

landmarks.name: Uspallata Mountain Base
landmarks.desc: Strategic staging oasis on RN 7 for trucks awaiting international pass clearance.

landmarks.name: Potrerillos Reservoir Dam
landmarks.desc: Major hydroelectric reservoir and mountain highway crossing over Mendoza River.

landmarks.name: Puente del Inca Natural Bridge
landmarks.desc: Historic natural arch rock formation and supply corridor point on RN 7.

landmarks.name: Punta de Vacas Border Station
landmarks.desc: Argentine national gendarmerie checkpost and historic trans-Andean railway junction.

landmarks.name: Los Andes Inland Port Terminal
landmarks.desc: Primary terrestrial customs clearance and cargo holding terminal for Chilean imports.

landmarks.name: San Felipe Valley Hub
landmarks.desc: Agricultural and supply distribution center of the upper Aconcagua river basin.

landmarks.name: Guardia Vieja Checkpoint
landmarks.desc: Mandatory winter chain inspection post on Route 60 ascending to Los Caracoles.

landmarks.name: Los Caracoles Switchback Pass
landmarks.desc: World-famous 29 continuous hairpin curves climbing 1,500m up the Andean wall.

landmarks.name: Aconcagua Provincial Park Gate
landmarks.desc: Base entrance to Mount Aconcagua (6,961m), the highest peak in the Western Hemisphere.

landmarks.name: Polvaredas Highway Maintenance Base
landmarks.desc: Strategic snowplow and heavy road machinery depot operated by Argentine Highway Dept.

landmarks.name: Cacheuta Thermal Tunnel
landmarks.desc: Scenic mountain tunnel linking the pre-cordillera to the city of Mendoza.

landmarks.name: Las Cuevas Frontier Outpost
landmarks.desc: Final Argentine settlement before the international border tunnel at 3,200m altitude.

landmarks.name: Farellones Mountain Base
landmarks.desc: Historic mountain village commanding access to three premier high-altitude ski valleys.

landmarks.name: Valle Nevado Logistics Depot
landmarks.desc: South America's largest ski complex and high-altitude emergency helipad.

landmarks.name: El Colorado Meteorological Station
landmarks.desc: Andean weather observatory and critical mountain communication mast.

landmarks.name: La Parva High Lookout
landmarks.desc: Northern ski base overlooking the Santiago urban basin from high Andean ridges.

landmarks.name: San José de Maipo Civil Center
landmarks.desc: Communal capital of Cajón del Maipo valley coordinating water and energy logistics.

landmarks.name: El Volcán Geological Node
landmarks.desc: Upper valley gateway towards San José Volcano and high-altitude copper deposits.

landmarks.name: Baños Morales Rescue Station
landmarks.desc: Alpine rescue center and thermal spring staging base near El Morado Glacier.

landmarks.name: Embalse El Yeso Reservoir Dam
landmarks.desc: 250-million-cubic-meter turquoise alpine reservoir providing drinking water to 7 million residents.

landmarks.name: Rancagua Agro-Industrial Hub
landmarks.desc: Capital of O'Higgins region; junction for the world's largest underground copper complex.

landmarks.name: Sewell Mining Heritage Site
landmarks.desc: Historic 'City of Stairs' mountain mining city built on steep Andean cliffs.

landmarks.name: El Teniente Mine Complex
landmarks.desc: World's largest underground copper mine with over 3,000 km of subterranean tunnels.

landmarks.name: Coya Hydroelectric Substation
landmarks.desc: Centenary hydroelectric generation plant harnessing the turbulent Cachapoal River.

landmarks.name: Machalí Pre-Cordillera Terminal
landmarks.desc: Fast-growing logistics and residential terminal at the foot of the Andes mountain range.

landmarks.name: Termas de Cauquenes Thermal Post
landmarks.desc: Oldest thermal spa in Chile situated deep within the Cachapoal river canyon.

landmarks.name: Rengo Central Valley Depot
landmarks.desc: Vital food supply and fruit processing node along the Pan-American Highway.

landmarks.name: San Fernando Trans-Andean Depot
landmarks.desc: Strategic branching point towards coastal Pichilemu and eastern Andean thermal routes.

landmarks.name: Termas del Flaco Mountain Post
landmarks.desc: Deep Andean valley known for dinosaur footprints and seasonal hot mineral springs.

landmarks.name: Paso Vergara (Paso del Planchón)
landmarks.desc: Seasonal trans-Andean route beneath the active Peteroa Volcano.

landmarks.name: Curicó Fruit & Wine Logistics Hub
landmarks.desc: Major agri-logistics export center for cherries, apples, and central valley wines.

landmarks.name: Romeral Pre-Cordillera Gateway
landmarks.desc: Chile's cherry capital and direct highway access to the Teno river gorge.

landmarks.name: Los Queñes River Confluence Base
landmarks.desc: Picturesque confluence of the Teno and Claro rivers used for hydrological monitoring.

landmarks.name: Talca Regional Capital Command
landmarks.desc: Regional capital of Maule; western origin of the Pehuenche International Corridor.

landmarks.name: San Clemente Pehuenche Base
landmarks.desc: Gateway municipality organizing logistics and safety convoys heading to Argentina via Pehuenche.

landmarks.name: Laguna del Maule Volcanic Caldera
landmarks.desc: Vast high-altitude volcanic field and natural reservoir monitored 24x7 for seismic unrest.

landmarks.name: Paso Pehuenche All-Weather Pass
landmarks.desc: Modern paved international pass connecting Chile's Maule Region with Argentina's southern Mendoza.

landmarks.name: Bardas Blancas Highway Junction
landmarks.desc: Critical junction connecting the famous RN 40 north-south axis with trans-Andean RN 145.

landmarks.name: Malargüe Southern Andean Logistics City
landmarks.desc: Home to the Pierre Auger Observatory, mining operations, and southern Mendoza fuel storage.

landmarks.name: Las Leñas Premier Ski Valley
landmarks.desc: World-famous ski valley with extensive lodging and emergency medical clinic at 2,240m.

landmarks.name: Los Molles Thermal Hamlet
landmarks.desc: Sulphurous hot springs settlement serving as an emergency fallback base for Las Leñas.

landmarks.name: San Rafael Oasis Logistics Terminal
landmarks.desc: Second largest city in Mendoza; central hub for southern wine, food security, and hydroelectric networks.

landmarks.name: Cañón del Atuel Hydroelectric Gorge
landmarks.desc: Spectacular 45 km canyon housing 4 major hydroelectric dams generating clean Andean power.

landmarks.name: El Nihuil Dam Reservoir Terminal
landmarks.desc: Enormous 9,600-hectare lake and dam regulating water for the vast San Rafael agricultural oasis.
